hero.descriptionPrefix: KeyGo is the identity management platform that centralizes user access, protects your applications, and lets each person see
hero.descriptionSuffix: without friction and with the security your organization deserves.

secureAccess.label: Unified sign-in
secureAccess.desc: One login for all your applications

totalControl.label: Role-based permissions

multiTenant.label: Centralized management

features.title: Everything you need to manage identities
features.description: KeyGo brings security best practices into one cohesive platform, reducing complexity without losing control.

authentication.title: Standards-based authentication
authentication.description: Implements OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE natively. No browser secrets, no interception risks.

roleAccess.title: Role-based access control
roleAccess.description: Define precise permissions for global admins, tenant admins, and end users. Each role sees exactly what it needs.

multiTenant.title: Native multi-tenant
multiTenant.description: Manage multiple organizations from a single instance. Each tenant has isolated users, apps, and settings.

jwt.title: Secure JWT tokens
jwt.description: Issue RS256-signed tokens and validate them through JWKS. Silent refresh runs automatically before session expiration.

clientApps.title: Client app management
clientApps.description: Register and manage apps that integrate with KeyGo. Control redirect URIs, scopes, and each app lifecycle.

api.title: Documented REST API
api.description: Complete OpenAPI v3 docs. Integrate KeyGo into your stack in minutes with clear contracts and consistent responses.

howItWorks.title: Frictionless security in three steps
howItWorks.description: KeyGo handles security complexity in the background. Your users only see fast and smooth access.

step1.title: The user signs in
step1.description: Users access with their credentials through a secure login screen managed by KeyGo. No matter which app they start from, the experience is always the same.
step1.detail: A single access point for all your applications.

step2.title: KeyGo verifies and authorizes
step2.description: KeyGo validates identity, checks permissions, and establishes an active session automatically. Everything happens in the background without disrupting work.
step2.detail: The session renews automatically so no one loses work.

step3.title: Personalized profile-based access
step3.description: Each user lands directly on their panel: global administrators, tenant owners, and end users see exactly the tools that match their permissions.
step3.detail: No manual setup: permissions are applied automatically.

roles.title: The right access for every person
roles.description: KeyGo adapts experience and permissions automatically by role, read directly from the JWT token.

admin.title: Global Administrator
admin.description: Full control over the KeyGo platform. Manage tenants, configure the system, and supervise all activity from one panel.

tenantAdmin.title: Tenant Administrator
tenantAdmin.description: Autonomous management inside your organization. Manage users, permissions, and configuration without depending on the central tech team.

tenantUser.title: System user
tenantUser.description: Secure, personalized access to tenant applications. Manage profile, sessions, and preferences independently.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits best
pricing.description: Managed cloud or deployment on your own servers - KeyGo adapts to each organization's needs, with no fine print.
pricing.footerPrefix: Does your organization have specific compliance or data sovereignty requirements?
pricing.footerSuffix: and we will design the ideal solution together.

platformOverview.question: What is the Platform section for?
platformOverview.answer: It centralizes the global view of tenants, applications, and users for general administration.

platformTenants.question: Where do I manage tenants?
platformTenants.answer: From the Tenants option in the Platform menu, where you can review details, status, and administrative actions.

platformAppsUsers.question: How are Apps and Users related in Platform?
platformAppsUsers.answer: Apps and Users represent the system catalog and actors. Effective relationships are managed through access/memberships by role.

accessAuditOverview.question: What is included in Access and audit?
accessAuditOverview.answer: It includes views for access control and traceability of relevant system events.

accessAuditDifference.question: What is the difference between Access and Audit?
accessAuditDifference.answer: Access shows operational permission state; Audit focuses on historical traceability and action tracking.

securitySessions.question: What do I see in Security > Sessions?
securitySessions.answer: A summary of active/expired sessions to monitor authentication activity.

securityTokens.question: When should I review Tokens or Signing Keys?
securityTokens.answer: When you need to validate cryptographic status and the lifecycle of system security credentials.

systemApi.question: What is System > API for?
systemApi.answer: It provides backend operational information and general status of related services.

systemSlowLoading.question: What happens if a view is slow to load?
systemSlowLoading.answer: The system applies timeouts and controlled recovery to preserve UI continuity and show clear status feedback.

organizationOverview.question: What can I do in My organization?
organizationOverview.answer: Manage users and applications for your tenant from a central view designed for the keygo_tenant_admin role.

organizationUsersApps.question: In what order should I configure Users and Apps?
organizationUsersApps.answer: Define applications first, then assign users/memberships to keep permissions consistent from the start.

accessMemberships.question: What are Memberships?
accessMemberships.answer: They are access assignments between user, tenant, and application that define effective permissions.

accessSessions.question: Why review Sessions inside Access?
accessSessions.answer: It helps verify authentication activity and detect abnormal behavior early.

homeOverview.question: What can I find in Home as a tenant user?
homeOverview.answer: A quick summary of your enabled views and direct access to My access and Activity.

homeMyAccess.question: How do I review my current permissions?
homeMyAccess.answer: In My access you can see the applications and roles assigned to your account inside the tenant.

accountWhereChangeLanguage.question: Where can I change the interface language?
accountWhereChangeLanguage.answer: You can change it from Account settings or from the language selector in the dashboard top bar.

accountLanguageAutoDetection.question: How is the language selected when I do not set it manually?
accountLanguageAutoDetection.answer: The app uses the first available language in navigator.languages. If it matches Spanish, es-CL is applied; if it matches English, en-US is applied.

accountLanguageBrowserConfig.question: Why do I see Spanish if my operating system is in English?
accountLanguageBrowserConfig.answer: Automatic mode reads your browser web-language preferences, which may differ from the browser UI language or your operating system language.
